description: Source code for team management in the Battle for Wesnoth game, including team info, shroud and fog mechanics, and team interactions.

classes.name: team
classes.description: Represents a team in the game, managing resources, villages, visibility, and team properties.

classes.name: team::team_info
classes.description: Stores static information about a team, such as name, color, objectives, and AI parameters.

classes.name: team::target
classes.description: Represents a target criteria for AI decision-making within a team.

classes.name: team::shroud_map
classes.description: Manages the visibility/shroud data for a team, including shared visibility with allies.

methods.name: team::team_info::team_info
methods.description: Constructor that initializes team info from configuration data.

methods.name: team::write
methods.description: Serializes team data into a configuration object.

methods.name: team::team
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a team with configuration and starting gold.

methods.name: team::get_village
methods.description: Adds a village to the team and fires a capture event.

methods.name: team::lose_village
methods.description: Removes a village from the team.

methods.name: team::new_turn
methods.description: Updates resources at the start of a new turn.

methods.name: team::set_time_of_day
methods.description: Adjusts AI parameters based on the current turn and time of day.

methods.name: team::shroud_map::value
methods.description: Returns whether a tile is visible or shrouded.

methods.name: team::shroud_map::shared_value
methods.description: Returns shared visibility value across multiple maps.
